title: A Present For Santa
hook: 平安夜，多出来一份礼物——是给圣诞老人的，可圣诞老人住在北极。

cells.en: It is Christmas Eve. Dora is at Abuela's house. She has a present for Boots.
cells.cn: 平安夜，Dora 在奶奶家，树下的礼物堆得像小山，她给 Boots 准备了一份。

cells.en: There is one more present. It is for Santa! But Santa lives at the North Pole.
cells.cn: 还剩一份礼物，是送给圣诞老人的！可圣诞老人住在遥远的北极。

cells.en: Map says: “Mountains, river, North Pole!” First they must cross the mountains.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先过雪山，再过河，最后到北极。

cells.en: A little blue train comes. “We're going to the North Pole!” says Dora.
cells.cn: 蓝色小火车开过来，Dora 抱着礼物说：“我们要去北极啦！”

cells.en: The train goes through the snow. The present is shaped like a rectangle.
cells.cn: 小火车穿过雪地，礼物盒是长方形的，抱在怀里稳稳的。

cells.en: On the mountain they meet a big snow cat. It is white and very funny.
cells.cn: 雪山上他们遇到一只大雪猫，白白的，样子特别逗。

cells.t: Do You See the North Pole?
cells.en: They walk and walk. “Do you see the North Pole?” “Yes! Over there!”
cells.cn: 他们走啊走，互相问：“你看到北极了没有？”——“看到了，就在那边！”

cells.en: Santa opens the present. It is a guitar! He plays it and sings “¡Feliz Navidad!”
cells.cn: 圣诞老人打开礼物——是一把吉他！他弹起来，唱着“圣诞快乐”。

cells.en: Santa and the elves say thank you. Everyone is happy on Christmas Eve.
cells.cn: 圣诞老人和小精灵一起道谢，平安夜的雪地里全是笑声。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “A Present For Santa”.
ending: In the end, Santa gets the guitar and plays it. My favorite part is ______.
